_comment: IONO-FLOAT CARD, ARM 2 of 2 — qz0_iofloat (3 h, 63 sta, DOY-129, cold).  The
uncombined-PPP-RTK iono-float arm (Odijk/Teunissen CC-R in estimative content):
_ft63_qz0.json deltas PLUS the tie release.  representation_sigma_tecu 5 -> 50
(8.1 m — informationally negligible against the ~0.5-1 m code channel, ~1-2% weight)
releases the SH field's grip on the per-LOS iono states while the FIELD stays ON and
co-estimated (kaula-anchored, rank-safe, diagnostics alive) — honoring the letter and
the Jul-3 substance of 'SH-VTEC always on' (low-el iono is absorbed by the FREE
per-LOS states here, more absorption than tight ties, not less).  Mech-B
(rep_error_*) OFF as a set — a deviation carry about a field with no grip is
meaningless.  layer2 OFF (its cross-space was an amplifier; fewer moving parts).
sh_health_gate OFF + deweight adaptive OFF: both key on tie residuals/a00 bands that
are meaningless once the ties are loose — a00 WARN lines in the log are EXPECTED and
benign in this arm.  raim/clock_runaway/adm_screen stay armed (fingerprint-safe QC).
KNOWN COST (accepted, user decision 2026-08-02): GF/DCB separation over long windows
— code biases and iono trade a GF lump; emitted products stay internally consistent
as a SET (TK-2015 one-model) but external OSB interop is paused in this mode.  Watch
rx-CB excursion counters + clock spread for the GF-wander class.
PREDICTION (committed 2026-08-02, project_dd_spillway_rootcause): mature-DD steps
collapse toward the sub-0.5 cyc/ep class, structure function flattens (constancy
finally visible), D5 flags collapse toward the raw-slip population, frac circR shows
the first real upward trend — but NOT integer-grade at 3 h (code-noise-limited
sqrt-K: ~0.4-0.8 cyc).  total_IF hr2 within ~10% of churn_v5b = the no-harm gate;
a large move here means the tie rows were load-bearing for the clock split after
all, and the arm FAILS regardless of how constant the ambiguities became.
